notes: The above information shows that in almost all the States & UTs who provided the data on the
subject, sufficient staff are available for administration of jail institutions. Among the various categories,
Jail Staff Cadre, who are exclusive for jail institutions well trained in jail management and
administration are posted in all the jails. This class of staff plays a major role and shares a large
percentage of the total jail staff in the various jails. The Jail Cadre staff are ably supervised and
controlled by officers and supported by Correctional Staff, Medical Staff (exclusively for the jail and
